name: hf-predictive-quiet-controls
purpose: Conditional controls fixed before the first physical candidate result. Run only if the paired oblique discriminator restores exact A delivery with unchanged DATA. Order prioritizes wrong-key integrity: enabling completion must not turn existing false DATA into accepted false content. Then run noise, matched endpoint-Off, and fresh B payload/noise holdout. Stop expansion on a new accepted incorrect message, new premature completion, changed DATA, or lost previously correct delivery; preserve failure receipts. These are four channel realizations with two policies each, not eight independent trials. No general operational promotion follows.
